entries.source: Shadowblades are Rogues that are touched by the gift of magic, able to kill with their daggers under a veil of stealth while casting spells to enhance their performance and survival.
entries.target: 影舞者是拥有魔法天赋的盗贼，能在潜行的掩护下用匕首杀敌，同时施展法术增强战斗和生存能力。

entries.source: They use the schools of Phantasm, Temporal, Divination and Conveyance magic to enhance their arts.
entries.target: 他们使用幻术、时空、侦查和传送系法术来增强自身的技艺。

entries.source: The wilds of Maj'Eyal are not a safe place. Untamed beasts and wandering dragons may seem a great threat, but the true perils walk on two legs. Thieves and brigands, assassins and opportunistic adventurers, even mad wizards and magic-hating zealots all carry danger to those who venture beyond the safety of city walls.
entries.target: 马基·埃亚尔的野外不是个安全的地方。野兽和到处游荡的龙似乎是巨大的威胁，然而真正危险的是两条腿的人。窃贼、强盗、刺客、投机冒险家、疯狂的巫师，甚至憎恶魔法的狂热者，都会给那些走出安全城墙的冒险者带来危险。

entries.source: Amidst this chaos wanders one class of rogue that has learned to take by force rather than subterfuge. With refined techniques, agile feats and brawn-backed blades the Marauder seeks out his targets and removes them by the most direct methods. He uses dual weapons backed by advanced combat training to become highly effective in battle, and he is unafraid to use the dirtiest tactics when the odds are against him.
entries.target: 在这片混乱之中，游荡着一类学会了以武力而非诡计夺取所需的盗贼。凭借精湛的技巧、敏捷的身手和蛮力加持的刀刃，掠夺者搜寻目标，并以最直接的方式将其除掉。他们以高等战斗训练为后盾双持武器，在战斗中极具威力；形势不利时，他们也不惮使用最卑劣的手段。

entries.source: While able to take maximum advantage of their sling by using deft movements to avoid and confuse enemies that try to get close, the Skirmisher truly excels when fighting other ranged users.
entries.target: 虽然散兵能借助灵巧的移动躲避并迷惑试图接近的敌人，从而最大程度地发挥投石索的威力，但他们真正擅长的是与其他远程单位作战。

entries.source: They have mastered the use of their shield as well as their sling and are nearly impossible to defeat in a standoff.
entries.target: 他们既精通投石索，也精通盾牌的使用，在远距离对峙中几乎无人能击败他们。

entries.source: Warrior
entries.target: 战士系

entries.source: Warriors train in all aspects of physical combat. They can be juggernauts of destruction wielding two-handed greatswords, or massive iron-clad protectors with gleaming shields.
entries.target: 战士精通于各种物理系战斗技能，他们可以手持双手大剑造成成吨的打击，也可以身穿重甲手持盾牌成为一个强大的护卫。

entries.source: Berserker
entries.target: 狂战士

entries.source: A Berserker wields huge two-handed weapons of destruction, bringing pain and death to his foes as he cleaves them in two.
entries.target: 狂战士手持双手武器，以毁灭性的伤害将他的敌人砍成两半。

entries.source: A Berserker usually forfeits all ideas of self-defense to concentrate on what he does best: killing things.
entries.target: 狂战士通常专注于造成伤害而忽视自我防御。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Constitution
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是力量和体质。

entries.source: Bulwark
entries.target: 盾战士

entries.source: A Bulwark specializes in weapon and shield combat, rarely leaving the cover of her many protective techniques.
entries.target: 盾战士精通武器与盾牌格斗，很少离开其诸多防护技巧的庇护。

entries.source: A good Bulwark is able to withstand terrible attacks from all sides, protected by her shield, and when the time comes lash out at her foes with incredible strength.
entries.target: 一个好的盾战士能够使用盾牌承受来自各方的攻击，当时机一到就立即将对手置于死地。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Dexterity
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和敏捷。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 Strength, +2 Dexterity, +2 Constitution
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 力量，+2 敏捷，+2 体质

entries.target: #GOLD#每等级生命加值：#LIGHT_BLUE# +6

entries.source: Archer
entries.target: 弓箭手

entries.source: Archers are dexterous ranged fighters, able to pin their foes to the ground and rain down a carpet of arrows on them.
entries.target: 弓箭手是身手矫健的远程战士，能将他的敌人钉在原地再射出如雨般的箭矢消灭对手。

entries.source: Skilled archers can fire special shots that pierce, cripple or pin their foes.
entries.target: 技艺娴熟的弓箭手可以射出特殊的箭矢，可以射穿、致残或者将目标钉在原地。

entries.source: Archers can become good with either longbows or slings.
entries.target: 弓箭手可以专精于长弓或投石索。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Dexterity and Strength (when using bows) or Cunning (when using slings)
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：敏捷和力量（装备弓时）或灵巧（装备投石索）

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +2 Strength, +5 Dexterity, +0 Constitution

entries.source: Arcane Blade
entries.target: 奥术之刃

entries.source: The Arcane Blade is a warrior who has been touched by the gift of magic.
entries.target: 奥术之刃是一个拥有魔法的战士。

entries.source: Their use of magic is innate and not really studied; as such they do not naturally regenerate mana and must use external means of recharging.
entries.target: 他们的魔法并非习得而是与生俱来的，因此他们的法力无法自然恢复，必须借助外部手段来补充。

entries.source: They can cast spells from a limited selection but have the unique capacity to 'channel' their attack spells through their melee attacks.
entries.target: 他们能施展一些有限的法术，并且独有将攻击法术「导引」进近战攻击的能力。

entries.source: They are adept with two-handed weapons, for the sheer destruction they can bring.
entries.target: 他们擅长使用双手武器，看重的是其所能带来的纯粹破坏力。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength, Cunning and Magic
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量、灵巧和魔力。

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+0 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 魔力，+0 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.target: #GOLD#每等级生命加值：#LIGHT_BLUE# +2

entries.source: Brawler
entries.target: 格斗家

entries.source: Though you may fight alone against many, destined to fight till you die, still you do not relent. In a ring of blood you learn that a pair of fists can face the world.
entries.target: 纵使你独自一人面对千军万马，注定战至最后一刻，你依然绝不退缩。在鲜血之环中，你学会了一双拳头就足以面对整个世界。

entries.source: The ravages of the Spellblaze stretched armies thin and left many unprotected. Not everyone could afford the luxury of a weapon.
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸的肆虐让军队捉襟见肘，许多人失去了保护。不是每个人都买得起武器这样的奢侈品。

entries.source: Without steel or iron, poor communities of all races turned to the strength of their own bodies for defense against the darkness.
entries.target: 没有钢铁，各个种族的贫穷社群只能依靠自身的力量来抵御黑暗。

entries.source: Whether a pit-fighter, a boxer, or just an amateur practitioner, the Brawler's skills are still handy today.
entries.target: 无论是地下拳场斗士、拳击手，还是业余习武者，格斗家的技能直到今天依然十分有用。

entries.source: Many of the Brawler's abilities will earn combo points which they can use on finishing moves that will have added effect.
entries.target: 格斗家的许多技能可以累积连击点数然后用一个终结技能造成额外的打击效果。

entries.source: The unarmed fighting styles the Brawler uses rely on maneuverability and having both hands available. As such, they cannot make use of their training wearing massive armour or while a weapon or shield is equipped.
entries.target: 格斗家的徒手战斗风格依赖机动性，并需要空出双手，因此在身穿板甲或装备武器、盾牌时，他们无法使用这些训练成果。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength, Dexterity, and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量、敏捷和灵巧

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 Strength, +3 Dexterity, +0 Constitution
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +3 力量，+3 敏捷，+0 体质

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +0 魔力，+0 意志，+3 灵巧

entries.source: Wilder
entries.target: 野性系

entries.source: Natural abilities can go beyond mere skill. Experience the true powers of nature to learn of its amazing gifts.
entries.target: 自然能力超越了纯粹的技能。经历自然的真正力量来领略它神奇的恩赐。

entries.source: Wilders are one with nature, in one manner or another. There are as many different Wilders as there are aspects of nature.
entries.target: 野性系以各种方式与自然融为一体。正如自然有着众多方面一样，野性系职业也多种多样。

entries.source: They can take on the aspects of creatures, summon creatures to them, feel the druidic call, ...
entries.target: 他们可以继承某些生物的特性技能，也可以召唤生物，或感受德鲁伊的召唤，……

entries.source: Summoner
entries.target: 召唤师

entries.source: Not all might comes from within. Hear the invocations of nature, hear its calling power. See that from without we can find our true strengths.
entries.target: 并非所有的力量都源自内在。倾听自然的祈咒，聆听它的召唤之力，要明白我们能从外界找到真正的力量。

entries.source: Summoners never fight alone. They are always ready to summon one of their many minions to fight at their side.
entries.target: 召唤师从不孤身战斗，他们时刻准备召唤出宠物为他们而战。

entries.source: Summons can range from a combat hound to a fire drake.
entries.target: 召唤师可以召唤从战争猎犬到火龙的各种生物。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Willpower and Cunning
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：意志和灵巧。

entries.source: Wyrmic
entries.target: 龙战士

entries.source: Sleek, majestic, powerful... In the path of dragons we walk, and their breath is our breath. See their beating hearts with your eyes and taste their majesty between your teeth.
entries.target: 矫健、雄壮、强大……我们行走在巨龙之道上，它们的吐息便是我们的吐息。用你的双眼凝视它们跳动的心脏，在你的齿间品味它们的威严。

entries.source: Wyrmics are fighters who have learnt how to mimic some of the aspects of the dragons.
entries.target: 龙战士是学会模仿巨龙部分特质的战士。

entries.source: They have access to talents normally belonging to the various kind of drakes.
entries.target: 他们从不同的龙中学习技能。

entries.source: Their most important stats are: Strength and Willpower
entries.target: 他们最重要的属性是：力量和意志。

entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE# * +5 力量，+0 敏捷，+1 体质

entries.source: Oozemancer
entries.target: 软泥使

entries.source: Magic must fail, magic must lose, nothing arcane can face the ooze...
entries.target: 魔法必定失败，魔法终会消亡，任何奥术能量都不能对抗软泥的力量…

entries.source: Oozemancers separate themselves from normal civilisation so that they be more in harmony with Nature. Arcane force are reviled by them, and their natural attunement to the wilds lets them do battle with abusive magic-users on an equal footing.
entries.target: 软泥使将自己和正常文明割裂，让自己与自然更加和谐。他们憎恶奥术之力，而与生俱来的自然亲和让他们得以与滥用魔法者势均力敌地交战。

entries.source: They can spawn oozes to protect and attack from a distance while also being adept at harnessing the power of mindstars and psiblades.
entries.target: 他们能制造软泥怪，来保护自己或远距离攻击对方，同时也能利用灵晶和心灵利刃来强化自己。

entries.source: Stone Warden
entries.target: 岩石守卫

entries.source:
The Spellblaze's scars may be starting to heal,
but little can change how the partisans feel.
Nature and arcane could bridge their divide -
and when it comes down to it, gold won't take sides...
entries.target:
魔法大爆炸留下的裂痕或许正开始愈合。
然而人们心中的偏见仍没有消失。
自然与奥术本可弥合分歧——
在这两者之间，金钱从不站队……
